_doc: Pre-registration of the lab event study (owner decision 2026-11-05). Written and committed BEFORE the event study was run on any data; event_study.py reads the adoption specifications from here, so a re-run on the final paper set or detector v3 uses exactly these thresholds. Changing this file after seeing results is a protocol change and must be reported as such.

adoption.unit: lab (strict membership: the PI is on the byline)
adoption.floor: pooled mean over lab-years in the floor window (lab-years with at least min_scored scored papers)
adoption.sd: pooled standard deviation of the same lab-year metric in the floor window
adoption.rule: adoption year = first year t <= last_year-1 in which the lab-year metric exceeds floor + k*SD in t and in t+1 (sustained for sustain_years consecutive years, each with at least min_scored scored papers); never-adopters = no such year; a lab whose only exceedance is the last year cannot be confirmed as sustained: censored, left out of the primary comparison

S1_primary.doc: share of scored full-text papers with ai_share >= 0.25

S6_abstract.doc: share of papers whose abstract is flagged (every paper with an abstract; no full-text selection)

S7_ipw.doc: S1 with the stabilised full-text IPW weights (Hajek mean per lab-year)

adoption.post_chatgpt_only_variant: adoption years before 2023 are detector noise (the floor window is pre-ChatGPT); the primary keeps them as pre-registered, a variant drops those labs

headline: mpd(specter2_proximity)
disp(specter2_proximity)
vendi(specter2_proximity)
nov3(specter2_proximity)
h_oa
dist_centroid(bt_qwen3_0p6b)
outcomes.wording_control: geometry and topic outcomes recomputed on the all-AI (polish) rewritten abstracts of the same papers; the event study is run on original, on rewritten, and on rewritten minus original (paired lab-years)

estimator.primary: Callaway-Sant'Anna group-time ATT(g,t), universal base period g-1, never-treated controls, no covariates; aggregated to event time with cohort-size weights; overall ATT = mean of post cells (e >= 0)
sensitivity: two-way fixed effects event study (lab and year FE, lab-clustered), shown to expose heterogeneity bias
estimator.inference: bootstrap over labs (resample labs with replacement, recompute everything), B = 300, percentile 95% intervals
estimator.pretrend: leads e = -5..-2 (base e = -1): each lead with its interval, a joint Wald test from the bootstrap covariance, and a linear pre-trend slope; reported whatever the result
estimator.placebo: permutation of the adoption cohorts among adopters and never-adopters (200 permutations): where the actual overall ATT falls in the permutation distribution
estimator.endogeneity: adopters vs never-adopters and early vs late adopters on pre-period features (size, school, department type, share of LLM-text papers up to 2022, pre-trend); a Spearman test of adoption year against the pre-2023 LLM-text share
